name: Rocky Mountain (Estes Park)
tagline: Alpine tundra, elk meadows and the highest paved road in the US
summary: Estes Park is the mountain town at the door of Rocky Mountain National Park. Drive Trail Ridge Road above 12,000 feet, hike from Bear Lake to Dream and Emerald lakes, watch bugling elk in Moraine Park in autumn, and stay at the Stanley Hotel that inspired The Shining.
seasonNote: Trail Ridge Road opens late May to mid October; September brings golden aspens and the elk rut. Timed-entry permits are needed in summer.
arrival: Denver International is about 1 hour 45 minutes by car; shuttles run from the airport.
gettingAround: A car, plus the free park shuttle to Bear Lake in summer.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Elk and bison burgers, Colorado craft beer and salt-water taffy.
buyTip: Taffy, outdoor gear and local art on Elkhorn Avenue.
baseArea: Downtown Estes Park or near the Beaver Meadows entrance
coverWiki: Rocky Mountain National Park Bear Lake
